goal: Stops a node from advertising a Tor exit node's IP as its own address on outbound clearnet connections
Prevents pollution of peer address tables with unreachable addresses across the network
reviewability: Ready for review, latest push addressed all inline review comments with tests and a comment
CI failure is claimed unrelated by the author and does not block reviewing the logic
agreement: Strong support because it stops advertising unreachable addresses (0xB10C, naiyoma, mzumsande)
Verified by testing the log behavior of the proxy skip case (naiyoma)
Nonblocking objection: doesn't fix transparent torification setups, acknowledged as a known gap (mzumsande)
Suggested implementation and test changes were incorporated by the author (naiyoma)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it reduces unnecessary gossip of unreachable Tor exit addresses across the network
Helps avoid wasted connection attempts and addrman pollution, per data showing 55-76% of exit IPs appearing in snapshots
Not a critical bug or security hole, just an incremental hygiene improvement that doesn't cover all misconfigurations

Small but real correctness fix to a commonly referenced setup doc, not high-stakes
